```{r}
#import NIClassifier prediction about native and invasive status of our zotus

status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |> 
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |> 
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict) |> 
  left_join(
    #import blast maps about native and invasive status of our zotus
  read.xlsx(here::here("output/tax_invasive.xlsx")) |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(zotu_id, status_genus)) |> 
  dplyr::rename(ibis_status = status_final) |> 
  #turn blank values into NA
  mutate(across(c(ibis_status, status_ni, status_genus), 
                ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA_character_, .x))) |> 
  mutate(Ibis  = tolower(ibis_status), 
         NiClassify = tolower(status_ni), 
         Blast = tolower(status_genus),
         zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id)) |> 
  select(-contains("status"))

summary_stats <- status |> 
  #calculate % introduces vs native vs NA for each method 
  #first pivot longer
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Ibis, NiClassify, Blast), 
               names_to = "method", values_to = "status") |>
  group_by(method, status) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  #pivot wider for nicer table
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) |> 
  dplyr::rename("No information available" = "NA")

#use gt table to produce a nice table for the publication
summary_stats |> 
  gt() |> 
  tab_header(title = "Summary of Invasive Status Predictions") |> 
  cols_label(method = "Prediction Method") |> 
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0) |> 
  cols_width(everything() ~ px(150)) |> 
  tab_spanner(label = "Invasive Status", columns = c("introduced", "native", "No information available")) |> 
  tab_source_note(source_note = "Data obtained through Ibis geolocation API, NIClassify predictions, BLAST mapping and species lookup") |> 
  gtsave(here::here("output/invasive_status_summary.html"))
```


Lekes transect
```{r}
# Filter to Oʻahu samples
meta_leke <- meta_data |> 
  filter(tolower(island) == "oahu") |> 
  select(sample_id, sample_site, shortname) |> 
   filter(str_detect(sample_id, "O_|K_|G_")) 

# Merge with ZOTU table
zotu_long <- zotu_df |> 
  inner_join(meta_leke, by = "sample_id") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("zotu"), names_to = "zotu", values_to = "count") |> 
  mutate(present = count > 0) 

# Create presence/absence per ridge
zotu_presence <- zotu_long |> 
  filter(present) |> 
  distinct(zotu, shortname) |> 
  mutate(value = TRUE) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = shortname, values_from = value, values_fill = FALSE) |> 
  #left join status table to get invasion status
  left_join(status, by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) 

#create two upset plots, one with colored bars from the Blast column and one with NIClassify



# Plot shared/unique ZOTUs as UpSet plot
blast_leke <- upset(zotu_presence,
         intersect = colnames(zotu_presence)[grepl("Koa|Ohia|Guava", colnames(zotu_presence))],
      name = "Shared ZOTUs",
      base_annotations = list(
    'Intersection size' = intersection_size(aes(fill = Blast))),
      width_ratio = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", na.value = "grey70") +
  ggtitle("Shared and Unique zOTUs of three different tree species")


ni_leke <- upset(zotu_presence,
         intersect = colnames(zotu_presence)[grepl("Koa|Ohia|Guava", colnames(zotu_presence))],
      name = "Shared ZOTUs",
      base_annotations = list(
    'Intersection size' = intersection_size(aes(fill = NiClassify))),
      width_ratio = 0.15) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", na.value = "grey70") +
  ggtitle("Shared and Unique zOTUs of three different tree species")


wrap_plots(blast_leke, ni_leke, ncol = 2)

#upset plot to see differences between the different trees
```

```{r}
# Filter to Oʻahu samples
meta_oahu <- meta_data |> 
  filter(tolower(island) == "oahu") |> 
  select(sample_id, sample_site, shortname) |> 
  filter(shortname == "Ohia") |> 
  filter(sample_id != "KT1") |>
  filter(sample_id != "KA5") 

# Merge with ZOTU table
zotu_long <- zotu_df |> 
  inner_join(meta_oahu, by = "sample_id") |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("zotu"), names_to = "zotu", values_to = "count") |> 
  mutate(present = count > 0) 

# Create presence/absence per ridge
zotu_presence <- zotu_long |> 
  filter(present) |> 
  distinct(zotu, sample_site) |> 
  mutate(value = TRUE) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_site, values_from = value, values_fill = FALSE) |> 
   left_join(status, by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) 

# Plot shared/unique ZOTUs as UpSet plot
upset(zotu_presence,
       intersect = c("Kaala", "Karl's Track", "Poamoho", "ʻAiea Ridge", "Manana Ridge"),
      name = "Shared ZOTUs",
      base_annotations = list(
    'Intersection size' = intersection_size(aes(fill = NiClassify))),
```

```{r}
# Merge ZOTU table to taxonomy
# Assuming taxonomy_df has a column named "zotu" and "species" or similar
taxonomy_long <- taxonomy_df |> 
  select(zotu_id, species = species) |> 
  # fallback to zotu if species is missing
  mutate(species = ifelse(is.na(species) | species == "", zotu_id, species)) |> 
  mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id))

zotu_long <- zotu_df |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -sample_id, names_to = "zotu_id", values_to = "count") |> 
  inner_join(meta_oahu, by = "sample_id") |> 
  inner_join(taxonomy_long, by = "zotu_id") |> 
  filter(count > 0)

# Use species name instead of ZOTU ID
species_presence <- zotu_long |> 
  distinct(species, sample_site) |> 
  mutate(present = TRUE) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_site, values_from = present, values_fill = FALSE)

all_ridges = species_presence |> 
  filter(if_all(-species, ~ .x == TRUE))
  

# Plot UpSet
upset(species_presence,
      intersect = colnames(species_presence)[-1],
      name = "Shared Species",
      base_annotations = list('Intersection size' = intersection_size()),
      width_ratio = 0.15) +
  ggtitle("Shared and Unique Species Across Oʻahu Ridges")
```

```{r}

# 1) Re-filter to your five Ohia ridges (dropping KT1 & KA5)
ohia_samples <- meta_data %>%
  filter(
    shortname   == "Ohia",
    sample_site %in% c("Kaala","Karl's Track","Poamoho","ʻAiea Ridge","Manana Ridge"),
    !sample_id  %in% c("KT1","KA5")
  ) %>%
  select(sample_id)

# 2) Build a long table of presences and join in NiClassify + elevation
plot_meta <- zotu_df %>%
  semi_join(ohia_samples, by = "sample_id") %>%     # keep only those samples
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to="zotu", values_to="count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%                             # presences only
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%                     # one row per sample–zotu
  left_join(status   %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify),
            by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) %>%
  left_join(meta_data %>% select(sample_id, sample_site, elevation),
            by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(if_else(NiClassify=="introduced","introduced","native"),
                        levels=c("native","introduced")),
    elevation  = factor(elevation, levels=c("low","mid","high"))
  ) |> 
  drop_na(NiClassify)

# 3) Summarize: count unique zOTUs per ridge × elevation × status, then % within each bar
elev_ridge_df <- plot_meta %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elevation, NiClassify) %>%
  summarise(zotus = n_distinct(zotu), .groups="drop") %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elevation) %>%
  mutate(pct = zotus / sum(zotus)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4) Plot: 5 facets (one per ridge), each with 3 bars (low/mid/high),
#    stacked by native vs introduced
ggplot(elev_ridge_df, aes(x = elevation, y = pct, fill = NiClassify)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_site, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C"),
    name   = "Status"
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Elevation",
    y     = "Percent of zOTUs",
    title = "Native vs. Introduced zOTUs at Low / Mid / High on Each Ridge"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
```{r}
# 1) Define your five Oʻahu Ohia ridges, dropping KT1 & KA5
ridges <- c("Kaala","Karl's Track","Poamoho","ʻAiea Ridge","Manana Ridge")

ohia_meta <- meta_data %>%
  filter(
    shortname   == "Ohia",
    sample_site %in% ridges,
    !sample_id  %in% c("KT1","KA5")
  )

# 2) Compute the tercile breaks on just these elevations
breaks <- quantile(
  ohia_meta$elevation_ft,
  probs   = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1),
  na.rm   = TRUE
)

# 3) Add an 'elev_band' factor (low/mid/high) to that subset
ohia_meta <- ohia_meta %>%
  mutate(
    elev_band = cut(
      elevation_ft,
      breaks         = breaks,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels         = c("low","mid","high")
    )
  )

# Quick counts to see your sample distribution:
ohia_meta %>%
  dplyr::count(sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = elev_band, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

# 4) Now rerun your zOTU pipeline, joining in elev_band instead of the old 'elevation'
plot_meta <- zotu_df %>%
  semi_join(ohia_meta, by = "sample_id") %>%     # only those Ohia samples
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to="zotu", values_to="count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%
  left_join(status   %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify),
            by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")) %>%
  left_join(ohia_meta %>% select(sample_id, sample_site, elev_band),
            by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(if_else(NiClassify=="introduced","introduced","native"),
                        levels = c("native","introduced")),
    elev_band  = factor(elev_band, levels = c("low","mid","high"))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(NiClassify)

# 5) Summarise and plot exactly as before, but by elev_band
elev_df <- plot_meta %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band, NiClassify) %>%
  summarise(zotus = n_distinct(zotu), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  mutate(pct = zotus / sum(zotus)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(elev_df, aes(x = elev_band, y = pct, fill = NiClassify)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_site, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C"),
    name   = "Status"
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Elevation band",
    y     = "Percent of zOTUs",
    title = "Native vs. Introduced zOTUs Across Elevation Bands on Each Ridge"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
```{r}

# 1) Filter to your five Ohia ridges (drop KT1 & KA5)
ridges <- c("Kaala","Karl's Track","Poamoho","ʻAiea Ridge","Manana Ridge")
ohia_meta <- meta_data %>%
  filter(
    shortname   == "Ohia",
    sample_site %in% ridges,
    !sample_id  %in% c("KT1","KA5")
  )

# 2) Compute tercile breaks on those elevations
breaks <- quantile(
  ohia_meta$elevation_ft,
  probs   = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1),
  na.rm   = TRUE
)

# 3) Bin into low/mid/high
ohia_meta <- ohia_meta %>%
  mutate(
    elev_band = cut(
      elevation_ft,
      breaks         = breaks,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels         = c("low","mid","high")
    )
  )

# 4) How many samples per ridge × band?
sample_counts <- dplyr::count(
  ohia_meta,
  sample_site, elev_band,
  name = "sample_n"
)

# 5) Pivot zOTU table, keep presences, join status + band
plot_meta <- zotu_df %>%
  semi_join(ohia_meta, by = "sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to="zotu", values_to="count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%
  left_join(
    status    %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify),
    by = c("zotu" = "zotu_id")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ohia_meta %>% select(sample_id, sample_site, elev_band),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NiClassify = factor(
      if_else(NiClassify=="introduced","introduced","native"),
      levels = c("native","introduced")
    )
  )

# 6) Count zOTUs per ridge×band×status
zotu_counts <- plot_meta %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band, NiClassify) %>%
  summarise(zotus = n_distinct(zotu), .groups="drop")

# 7) Merge in sample_n, compute pct, build x_label
summary_df <- zotu_counts %>%
  drop_na(NiClassify) %>%
  left_join(sample_counts, by = c("sample_site","elev_band")) %>%
  group_by(sample_site, elev_band) %>%
  mutate(pct = zotus / sum(zotus)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # shorten "Aiea Ridge" → "Aiea"
    ridge_short = str_replace(sample_site, " Ridge$", ""),
    x_label     = paste0(ridge_short, " ", elev_band, " (n=", sample_n, ")")
  )

# 8) Explicitly order x‐axis: ridges in your order, bands low→mid→high
x_levels <- summary_df %>%
  distinct(sample_site, elev_band, x_label, sample_n) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(sample_site, levels = ridges),
    factor(elev_band,  levels = c("low","mid","high"))
  ) %>%
  pull(x_label)

summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(x_label = factor(x_label, levels = x_levels))

# 9) Plot
ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = x_label, y = pct, fill = NiClassify)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(native = "#377EB8", introduced = "#E41A1C"),
    name   = "Status"
  ) +
  labs(
    x       = NULL,
    y       = "Percent of zOTUs",
    title   = "Native vs. Introduced zOTUs by Ridge & Elevation Band",
    caption = paste0(
      "Elevation bands on Ohia samples (feet):\n",
      "low  = ", round(breaks[1]), "–", round(breaks[2]), " ft; ",
      "mid  = ", round(breaks[2]), "–", round(breaks[3]), " ft; ",
      "high = ", round(breaks[3]), "–", round(breaks[4]), " ft"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.caption   = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
```{r}
# 1) Build the per‐sample data with elev_band exactly as before:
ridges <- c("Kaala","Karl's Track","Poamoho","ʻAiea Ridge","Manana Ridge")
ohia_meta <- meta_data %>%
  filter(shortname=="Ohia",
         sample_site %in% ridges,
         !sample_id %in% c("KT1","KA5")) %>%
  select(sample_id, sample_site, elevation_ft)

# tercile breaks
breaks <- quantile(ohia_meta$elevation_ft, probs = c(0,1/3,2/3,1), na.rm = TRUE)
ohia_meta <- ohia_meta %>%
  mutate(elev_band = cut(elevation_ft, breaks, labels = c("low","mid","high"), 
                         include.lowest=TRUE))

# long format + join
long_occ <- zotu_df %>%
  semi_join(ohia_meta, by="sample_id") %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to="zotu", values_to="count") %>%
  filter(count>0) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%
  left_join(status    %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify),
            by = c("zotu"="zotu_id")) %>%
  left_join(ohia_meta %>% select(sample_id, sample_site, elev_band),
            by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(NiClassify = if_else(NiClassify=="introduced","introduced","native"))

# per‐sample successes/failures
inv_by_sample <- long_occ %>%
  group_by(sample_site, sample_id, elev_band) %>%
  summarise(
    introduced = sum(NiClassify=="introduced"),
    native     = sum(NiClassify=="native"),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

# 2) Fit a GEE with sample_site as the “cluster” 
inv_by_sample <- inv_by_sample %>%
  mutate(ridge_id = as.numeric(factor(sample_site)))

gee2 <- geepack ::geeglm(
  cbind(introduced, native) ~ elev_band,
  id       = ridge_id,
  data     = inv_by_sample,
  family   = binomial,
  corstr   = "exchangeable"
)
summary(gee2)




gee_trend <- geepack::geeglm(
  cbind(introduced, native) ~ as.numeric(elev_band),
  id    = ridge_id,
  data  = inv_by_sample,
  family = binomial,
  corstr = "exchangeable"
)
summary(gee_trend)



```

```{r}

# 1) Re-compute per-sample proportions (introduced out of all classified+unclassified)
prop_df <- zotu_df %>%
  pivot_longer(-sample_id, names_to="zotu", values_to="count") %>%
  filter(count > 0) %>%
  distinct(sample_id, zotu) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_data %>% select(sample_id, sample_site, shortname),
    by = "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sample_site %in% c("ʻAiea Ridge","Manana Ridge"),
    shortname   %in% c("Ohia","Koa","Guava")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    status %>% select(zotu_id, NiClassify) %>% rename(zotu = zotu_id),
    by = "zotu"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    NiClassify = coalesce(NiClassify, "unclassified"),
    NiClassify = factor(NiClassify, levels=c("native","introduced","unclassified"))
  ) %>%
  count(sample_id, sample_site, shortname, NiClassify) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(NiClassify=="introduced") %>%
  transmute(
    sample_id,
    sample_site,
    tree        = recode(shortname,
                         "Ohia"  = "ʻōhiʻa Lehua",
                         "Koa"   = "koa",
                         "Guava" = "strawberry guava"),
    prop_intro = n / total
  )

# 2) Define the 3 pair-wise comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua","koa"),
  c("ʻōhiʻa Lehua","strawberry guava"),
  c("koa","strawberry guava")
)

# 3) Build the bar + SE plot with significance stars
ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = tree, y = prop_intro, fill = tree)) +
  geom_bar(stat="summary", fun="mean", width=0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(stat="summary", fun.data=mean_se, width=0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample_site, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy=1),
    limits = c(0,1), breaks = seq(0,1,0.2), expand = c(0,0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plant_colors) +
  stat_compare_means(
    aes(label = ..p.signif..),
    method           = "t.test",
    comparisons      = comparisons,
    p.adjust.method  = "holm",
    hide.ns          = FALSE,
    tip.length       = 0.01
  ) +
  labs(
    x        = "Tree species",
    y        = "Mean % introduced zOTUs ± SE",
    title    = "Invasion rate by Tree species at ʻAiea & Manana Ridges",
    subtitle = "Holm-adjusted pairwise t-tests (α=0.05)",
    fill     = "Tree"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1),
    legend.position= "none",
    strip.text     = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
